# Third-party material

Upstream skills and runtime files retain their original content. Repositories and
commit pins are in `../../framework.lock.json`.

- ECC: MIT, see ECC-LICENSE.txt.
- BMAD Method: MIT, see BMAD-LICENSE.txt; see BMAD-TRADEMARK.md for naming.
- evals-skills: Apache-2.0, see EVALS-SKILLS-LICENSE.txt.
- Ajv and transitive packages: their licenses are distributed with npm packages;
  exact versions and integrity fields are in ../../package-lock.json.

Project-specific integration documents, runner, schema and fixtures were created
for Travel Life. The trace fixtures are fabricated development data, not outputs
from any upstream project or a real travel reconstruction engine.
